name: Hyrule
startIntroPart1: Princess Zelda, heir to the old royal line, welcome. Hyrule is a land of green fields, quiet forests and busy roads, and its people have always valued peace and the open trade route.
startIntroPart2: Build farms and ranches, keep the caravans moving, and grow a kingdom whose bounty and wisdom can stand against any who would threaten it.
introduction: I am Zelda of Hyrule. May our roads be safe and our harvests plentiful.
neutralHello: Greetings, traveler. Hyrule's gates are open to honest trade.
hateHello: You are not welcome on our roads. Say what you came to say and go.
tradeRequest: Our merchants would gladly deal with yours. Shall we see what is fair?
declaringFriendship: Let our kingdoms walk the same road together.
declaringWar: You have threatened my people. Hyrule will answer.
attacked: Your blades are drawn against Hyrule? You will regret it.
defeated: The kingdom may fall, but the spirit of Hyrule will not.
denounced: You have betrayed our trust, and the world shall know it.
neutralDenouncing: I denounce your actions. Reconsider them.
hateDenouncing: You are a menace to all who value peace.
neutralRejectingDemand: Hyrule does not bend to demands.
hateRejectingDemand: Never. Take your demand and leave.
